name: Previous Expiry
description: This keyword returns the date of the last historic expiry of an expired instrument as a string in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the date of the last historic expiry of an expired instrument as a string in the format  YYYY-MM-DD.

![Example](./images/img-1712657579.png)

![Example](./images/img-1712657957.png)

In here you can input your instrument name, the expiry type and the offset of the expiry. 0 will give you the latest expired expiry, 1 will give you the previous to previous expiry and so on.  Note: You cannot add a negative number in the offset

This keyword is mainly used to check if today is the first day of a new series of a monthly or weekly contract.

![Example](./images/img-1712657433.png)

You can use the Previous Expiry keyword in days difference if you have strategies where the entry trade has to happen on the day after the expiry.
